text_block_list.text: (Yay, *clap clap clap*!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Thank goodness... I was able to run all 
the way to the end...)

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Cheval-chaaan! Congrats, you were so cool 
out there!!
On the way home from the racetrack—

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm so happy... To think Cheval-chan 
is making her Make Debut~.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Hey, have you decided which race you want 
to run? Your big sis ran it, so maybe 
you'll aim for the Triple Tiara?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —...What!? N-No way!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"See? If even my sister couldn't reach it, 
someone like me couldn't possibly..."

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Looks pretty good to me, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
You know, I think taking on challenges is 
important. Having bigger dreams makes me 
feel like pushing myself harder.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: Because I have one too... a dream...

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
I want to win domestic GⅠ races fair and 
square... and then someday run in overseas 
races too—

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
You had one too, didn't you, Cheval-chan? 
A huuuge dream that you absolutely wanted 
to come true.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, that's...!

Cheval Grand's dream of becoming a "great 
Umamusume"—

Even with her best friend, she still 
didn't seem confident enough to call it a 
dream.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
It's fine... Right now, I have my hands 
full just dealing with what's in front of 
me.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
I see... yeah. Cheval-chan really is 
amazing after all.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Giving your all to what's right in front 
of you is important too. That's a very 
solid way of thinking, and I like it.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Uh... N-No, not at all... Not even 
close...
choice_data_list: (Cheval...)

text_block_list.text:
The next day, I asked her once more if 
there were any races she'd like to enter 
going forward, but—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... I just don't really know how 
to choose that kind of thing...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I know I have to answer more clearly and 
crisply, but...
choice_data_list:
No, I just wanted to know if you had any 
preferences.

No, I just wanted to know if you had any 
preferences.

text_block_list.text:
Of course, there are Umamusume whose dream 
is to run in specific races, but there are 
also plenty who aren't like that.

"If anything, choosing races based on your 
Umamusume's aptitudes and the tendencies 
of other entrants is a crucial part of a 
Trainer's job."
Meanwhile, however—
choice_data_list:
Let me know as soon as you find a race you 
want to run in.

Tell me as soon as you find a race you 
want to enter, okay?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... yes. Understood!

I want Cheval Grand to eventually become 
confident enough to declare which races 
she wants to run on her own.

Even so, that's a conversation for after 
her heart has matured. For now, I should 
be the one to give her short-term goals.
choice_data_list: (First, we need to decide on a direction!)

text_block_list.text:
In order to set our goals for the Junior 
Class, I should first get a grasp on her 
strengths and weaknesses.

What weighs on Cheval Grand's mind the 
most is the difference between herself and 
her older and younger sisters.

She's viewing it in terms of superiority 
and inferiority, but in truth, I feel her 
entire perspective might be off the mark.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —An endurance test... is it?
choice_data_list:
I just wanted to know my limits as they 
are now.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: That is your limit, then. ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Alright, first up is the shuttle run... 
Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —*pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Um, keep the pitch steady... Pull your 
legs in tight...
choice_data_list: Can you go next right away?
Can you go next right away?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes! I'm all right.

"And so, focusing mainly on aerobic 
training, we wrapped up a grueling day's 
routine—"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: U-Um... h-how was it?
choice_data_list:
You really are different from your older 
sisters.

You really are different from your older 
sisters.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Y... You're right... I don't have the kind 
of talent my sisters do—
choice_data_list: You're suited for long-distance races
Long-distance races are perfect for you!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: M-Me, running long distance...?

I nod firmly. Though expected, the trend 
became undeniable once measured.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Long distance... It's true I can't really 
picture Big Sis running long distances, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Because Big Sis is nimble, and she has 
great explosive power, so shorter 
distances suit her—
choice_data_list: How about you, then?
Then how about you?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not really cut out for miles or 
sprints...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I... I get nervous at the start, and too 
often the race ends before I can even give 
it my all—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I wish I could just burst into a sprint 
right away... It's like my engine takes a 
while to get revved up.

This is also what I felt from watching her 
until now. Short distances demand 
overwhelming speed. Her disposition simply 
wouldn't suit it.

Instead, she possesses incredible stamina 
and a sustained finishing burst.

While much of the training to build 
stamina is mundane and grueling, she also 
possesses the dedication to tackle it 
silently and earnestly.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'm... nothing like my big sister... 
So I feel like I'm no good, but...
choice_data_list:
Those differences are what make you 
strong!

Those differences are what make you 
strong!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh..., ......N-No, ...i-it can't be...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: …………Do I even have... any strengths...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I... I'm sorry... I know... you're trying 
to help cover for me, but...
choice_data_list: No, it's fine.
No, it's okay.

text_block_list.text:
I understand that being told out of the 
blue that she has a "strength," she can't 
quite process or accept it right now.

"If she could believe in herself that 
easily, she would have carried herself 
with much more confidence."
choice_data_list:
In return, just trust my words for a 
while.

In return, just trust my words for a 
while.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Trainer...-san...?

If she's scared to believe in herself, 
I'll believe in her in her place for now.

Let's first build up her running 
capabilities and turn those results into 
self-confidence for her.
choice_data_list: Let's make your tenacity your weapon.

Let's turn your tenacity into your 
greatest weapon.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ......Thank you... so much....

Her hesitation and averted gaze were 
likely expressions of Cheval Grand's inner 
conflict.

Yet, if you hadn't wished for it to 
"actually be true," you wouldn't have felt 
so conflicted in the first place.

Even so, in the Junior class, there are no 
long-distance races—the distance Cheval 
Grand is best suited for.

They decided that while she would enter 
races when the timing was right, her main 
focus would be dedicated to building up 
her body.
